standard.summary: 训练时按变化率智能跳过部分 block（Aircon）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Skips some blocks during training according to their rate of change (Aircon).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练时按变化率智能跳过部分 block（Aircon）。默认关闭；与固定 DiT BlockSkip 互斥（BlockSkip 优先）。

advanced_en.principle: During training, intelligently skips some blocks based on their change rate (Aircon). Off by default; mutually exclusive with fixed DiT BlockSkip (BlockSkip wins).
